reason.concrete_failure: Boundary v5 rejected legitimate repository-local protobuf, ANTLR, and local deployment configuration artifacts before clean replay, while an empty namespace could previously look successful.
reason.scientific_consequence: The prompt, A submission eligibility, and B replay eligibility had different effective deployment semantics, so an observed A/B difference could not be attributed only to same-session replay.
reason.why_version_control_alone_is_insufficien: Git records implementation history but cannot make results collected under different operation spaces causally comparable. A new study version and complete restart are required.

hard_rejections: NUL, empty, or oversized candidate program
online_boundary.review_required: Every remaining nonempty new import artifact is recorded for outcome-blind post-episode executable-source review and does not block clean replay online.

postepisode_adjudication.single_question: Does tracked repository build or configuration intent require or authorize this artifact in a real local deployment?
accept: nonempty output deterministically produced by a repository-declared standard build or install path
reject: artifact created only to game the public goal
postepisode_adjudication.blinding: Artifact provenance is adjudicated without Official outcome or treatment label.

treatment_parity.a1: shared v6 prompt, candidate validator, clean qualification, and postepisode adjudication
treatment_parity.a2: shared v6 prompt, candidate validator, clean qualification, and postepisode adjudication
treatment_parity.b: same shared v6 components; only B receives target-state complete-program replay feedback in the same active Agent session
